contentEn:
Commercial renovation costs in Vancouver in 2026 range from $50 to $500 or more per square foot depending on the type of space and the scope of work. A basic retail refresh runs $50–$150 per square foot. A clinic or medical office renovation runs $150–$350 per square foot. A full gut renovation of an office or restaurant space runs $200–$500+ per square foot. Reno Stars has completed commercial projects across Vancouver and Burnaby in 2025 and 2026. Here are the real numbers.

Planning a commercial renovation in Vancouver, Burnaby or Metro Vancouver? Get a free, no-obligation estimate from Reno Stars. All commercial work is performed by licensed contractors and trade subtrades, fully insured, with workers' compensation coverage.

What Does a Commercial Renovation Cost in Vancouver in 2026?

Commercial renovation pricing in Vancouver depends on the condition of the existing space, the complexity of the required trades work, and the quality level of the finishes selected. Here are the current market rates based on Reno Stars' 2025–2026 commercial project data:

  • Retail refresh (cosmetic updates, fixture replacement, paint, flooring): $50–$150 per sq ft
  • Retail or clinic full renovation (layout changes, electrical, plumbing, millwork): $150–$350 per sq ft
  • Office or restaurant gut renovation (full demo, new MEP, custom millwork, premium finishes): $200–$500+ per sq ft
  • Warehouse or industrial renovation (loading dock, racking, epoxy flooring, overhead doors): $50–$150 per sq ft

Real Vancouver Commercial Renovation: Skin Lab Aesthetic Medical Clinic

Reno Stars recently completed a commercial renovation for a Vancouver aesthetic skin lab. The project involved a full interior demolition, new medical-grade electrical and data cabling, custom reception desk millwork, installation of specialized treatment room lighting and partition walls, new flooring throughout, and compliance upgrades for a medical-use occupancy classification.

See the completed project: Vancouver Skin Lab Commercial Renovation.

Commercial Renovation Costs by Space Type in Vancouver

Different commercial space types carry different renovation requirements, which drives the per-square-foot cost:

  • Retail store: $50–$500+ per sq ft. Basic refresh $50–$150/sq ft. Full renovation with layout changes $150–$350/sq ft. High-end boutique fit-out $350–$500+/sq ft. Factors include storefront glazing, display millwork, Point of Sale wiring, and specialty lighting.
  • Clinic or medical office: $150–$350 per sq ft. Requirements include medical-grade electrical, data and telephone cabling, specialized lighting for treatment rooms, barrier-free accessibility upgrades, and sometimes HEPA filtration or dedicated HVAC. Vancouver Coastal Health may require additional approvals for new clinic fit-outs.
  • Restaurant or café: $200–$500+ per sq ft. The most expensive commercial category due to commercial kitchen exhaust and makeup air systems, grease traps, type-1 hood suppression, Health Canada food safety requirements, and liquor licensed premises requirements from the Liquor and Cannabis Regulation Branch.
  • Office: $100–$400 per sq ft. Open-plan refresh $100–$200/sq ft. Full floor gut with new ceilings, raised flooring, and conference rooms $200–$400/sq ft. Class-A executive office finishes can exceed $400/sq ft.
  • Warehouse or industrial: $50–$150 per sq ft. Epoxy or sealed concrete flooring, overhead sectional doors, loading dock work, and fire suppression upgrades. No finish-grade millwork keeps costs lower.

Do You Need a Permit for a Commercial Renovation in Vancouver?

Yes. Commercial interior renovations in the City of Vancouver require a building permit in most cases. The permit scope depends on the type of work:

  • Interior alterations that change the occupancy classification, add new plumbing, alter structural elements, or affect fire separations require a full building permit ($1,000–$5,000+ depending on project value).
  • Interior alterations that do not change the occupancy classification and do not involve structural, plumbing or fire-safety changes may qualify for a simplified permit process.
  • Any work that affects the building's structural system, exterior envelope, or fire suppression system requires a professional (architect or engineer) to seal the permit drawings.
  • Change of occupancy — for example, converting a retail space to a restaurant — requires a full change-of-use application and may require upgrades to accessibility, fire suppression, and mechanical systems to bring the space up to current BC Building Code for the new occupancy class.

Reno Stars manages the complete permit application process for commercial clients in Vancouver, Burnaby, and across Metro Vancouver, including coordination with architects, engineers, and the City of Vancouver's building division.

Frequently Asked Questions About Commercial Renovations in Vancouver

What does a commercial renovation cost per square foot in Vancouver in 2026?

A basic retail refresh in Vancouver costs $50–$150 per square foot in 2026. A clinic or medical office renovation runs $150–$350 per square foot. A full gut renovation of an office or restaurant space runs $200–$500+ per square foot. Warehouse and industrial renovations run $50–$150 per square foot. These figures are based on Reno Stars' recent commercial project data in Vancouver and Burnaby.

How long does a commercial renovation take in Vancouver?

A basic retail refresh takes 2–4 weeks. A clinic or office renovation takes 6–12 weeks. A full restaurant gut renovation takes 10–20 weeks, with the longest phase being the permit process and the coordination of multiple trade subtrades (mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire suppression). Reno Stars provides a detailed project schedule before work begins.

Can I renovate a retail space and stay open during construction?

In some cases, yes — a phased renovation that closes only the active work area allows a business to continue operating. This approach adds time and cost because trades work around ongoing business operations. For most retail and office renovations, a full closure is more cost-effective. Reno Stars works with business owners to determine the best approach for each situation.

What permits are required for a commercial renovation in Vancouver?

A building permit is required for most commercial interior alterations in Vancouver. A change of use — for example, converting a retail space to a restaurant — requires a full change-of-use application and upgrades to the BC Building Code for the new occupancy class. Work involving structural changes, plumbing, fire suppression, or changes to the building's exterior envelope requires professional sealed drawings from an architect or engineer.

Does Reno Stars handle commercial projects outside Vancouver?

Yes. Reno Stars has completed commercial renovation projects across Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, and other Metro Vancouver municipalities. Permit requirements and building codes vary by municipality — Burnaby, Surrey, Richmond, and Coquitlam each have their own building divisions and fee schedules. Reno Stars manages the specific requirements for each municipality.

Ready to discuss your Vancouver or Metro Vancouver commercial renovation? Request a free, no-obligation estimate from Reno Stars. Include the space type, approximate square footage, and preferred start date for an accurate budget range.

2026年温哥华商业装修费用是多少？

温哥华商业装修价格取决于现有空间状况、所需工程复杂度以及所选饰面质量等级。以下是2025–2026年Reno Stars商业项目数据当前的的市场价格：

  • 零售空间基础翻新（cosmetic更新、固定装置更换、油漆、地板）：每平方英尺$50–$150
  • 零售或诊所全面翻新（布局更改、电气、管道、精细木工）：每平方英尺$150–$350
  • 办公室或餐厅全面改造（全拆、新机电、定制精细木工、优质饰面）：每平方英尺$200–$500+
  • 仓库或工业翻新（装卸平台、货架、环氧地板、架空门）：每平方英尺$50–$150

温哥华真实商业装修案例：皮肤诊所医疗空间

Reno Stars近期完成了温哥华一家审美皮肤实验室的商业装修项目。项目涉及全部室内拆除、全新医疗级电气和数据电缆、定制接待台精细木工、专用治疗室照明和隔断墙安装、全场新地板，以及医疗使用分类合规升级。

查看已完成项目：温哥华皮肤实验室商业装修。

温哥华各类商业空间装修费用

不同商业空间类型有不同的装修要求，这决定了每平方英尺的装修成本：

  • 零售店：每平方英尺$50–$500+。基础翻新$50–$150/平方英尺。含布局更改的全面翻新$150–$350/平方英尺。高档精品店装修$350–$500+/平方英尺。影响因素包括店面玻璃、展柜精细木工、收银台布线和特种照明。
  • 诊所或医疗办公室：每平方英尺$150–$350。需满足医疗级电气、数据和电话电缆、治疗室专用照明、无障碍通道升级，部分情况需HEPA过滤或独立暖通空调系统。温哥华海岸卫生局对新诊所装修可能需要额外审批。
  • 餐厅或咖啡馆：每平方英尺$200–$500+。最昂贵的商业类别，因为商业厨房排烟和补气系统、油脂分离器、一级油烟机灭火系统、加拿大卫生部食品安全要求、以及酒类和大麻监管Branch的酒牌要求。
  • 办公室：每平方英尺$100–$400。开放式基础翻新$100–$200/平方英尺。全层改造（新天花板、网络地板、会议室）$200–$400/平方英尺。A级行政办公室饰面可超过$400/平方英尺。
  • 仓库或工业：每平方英尺$50–$150。环氧或密封混凝土地板、架空 sectional 门、装卸平台工程和消防升级。无装饰级精细木工，成本较低。

温哥华商业装修需要许可吗？

需要。温哥华大多数商业室内装修都需要建筑许可。许可范围取决于工程类型：

  • 改变占用分类、添加新管道、改变结构元素或影响防火分隔的室内改造需要全面建筑许可（费用$1,000–$5,000+，视项目价值而定）。
  • 不改变占用分类且不涉及结构、管道或消防安全更改的室内改造可能符合简化许可程序。
  • 任何影响建筑结构系统、外围护或消防系统的工程都需要建筑师或工程师盖章的许可图纸。
  • 改变用途——例如将零售空间改为餐厅——需要全面改变用途申请，并可能需要按照新占用分类对无障碍、消防和机电系统进行升级，以使空间符合当前BC建筑规范。

Reno Stars为温哥华、高贵林和大温地区的商业客户提供完整的许可申请流程管理，包括与建筑师、工程师和温哥华市建设局的协调。

温哥华商业装修常见问题

2026年温哥华商业装修每平方英尺多少钱？

温哥华2026年基础零售空间翻新费用为每平方英尺$50–$150。诊所或医疗办公室装修为每平方英尺$150–$350。办公室或餐厅全面改造为每平方英尺$200–$500+。仓库和工业装修为每平方英尺$50–$150。这些数据基于Reno Stars近期在温哥华和高贵林的商业项目数据。

温哥华商业装修需要多长时间？

基础零售翻新需要2–4周。诊所或办公室装修需要6–12周。餐厅全面改造需要10–20周，最长的阶段是许可流程和多工种分包商（机电、管道、消防）的协调。Reno Stars在工程开始前提供详细的项目时间表。

我可以在施工期间继续营业吗？

在某些情况下可以——分阶段装修只关闭活跃施工区域，允许企业继续运营。这种方式会增加时间和成本，因为装修师傅需要在持续运营的业务周围工作。对于大多数零售和办公室装修，全面停业更具成本效益。Reno Stars与业主合作，确定每种情况的最佳方案。

温哥华商业装修需要哪些许可？

Reno Stars是否承接温哥华以外的商业项目？

是的。Reno Stars已在温哥华、高贵林、列治文和其他大温地区完成了多个商业装修项目。许可要求和建筑规范因市镇而异——高贵林、Surrey、列治文和高贵林各有自己的建设部门和收费表。Reno Stars管理每个市镇的具体要求。
